commands.name: deep-research
commands.description: Deep research harness — fan-out web searches, fetch sources, adversarially verify claims, synthesize a cited report. (dynamic workflow)

commands.name: design
commands.description: Grant or revoke Claude agent access to your Design projects

commands.name: design-sync
commands.description: Push a React design system to claude.ai/design. This runs a converter that bundles the real component code (from Storybook or a bare package) and uploads it. Use when the user runs /design-sync or says "sync my design system to Claude Design".

commands.name: dataviz
commands.description: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. When the destination is a first-party document connector (host-designated, never self-described) that renders live charts, hand it the rows (inline, or as an uploaded data file the chart cites) rather than a rendered PNG/SVG — a picture of a chart loses hover, data inspection and per-value comments. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".

commands.name: update-config
commands.description: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by exercising it end-to-end and observing behavior — drive the affected flow, not just tests or typecheck. Run before committing nontrivial changes; bootstraps this repo's project verify skill if none exists yet. Don't invoke it on a diff that only touches tests, docs, or other code with no runtime surface to drive (a change to product source always has one) — there's nothing to observe.

commands.name: debug
commands.description: Enable debug logging for this session and help diagnose issues

commands.name: code-review
commands.description: Review the current diff, or a PR number/branch/path target, for correctness bugs (plus reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups where the model's review recipe covers them) at the given effort level (low|medium|high|xhigh|max: from few high-confidence findings up to many, some of them uncertain; ultra: deep multi-agent review in the cloud); with no level given, it reuses the level you typed last. Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review. Pass --max-findings <n> to report up to n findings, or --max-findings all for every finding. The choice stays until you pass --max-findings default. For ultra on a GitHub.com PR target, --post asks to post the finished review’s findings to the PR as a single comment from the user’s GitHub account (not a review; the launch dialog still confirms in interactive sessions, while non-interactive mode posts on the flag alone) and --no-post hides that option.

commands.name: simplify
commands.description: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.

commands.name: batch
commands.description: Research and plan a large-scale change, then execute it in parallel across 5–30 isolated worktree agents that each open a PR.

commands.name: fewer-permission-prompts
commands.description: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Health-check the user's Claude Code setup and fix issues: diagnose installation health — what the `claude doctor` terminal diagnostics cover — from local data (duplicate or leftover installs, PATH, unparseable settings files, broken or colliding agent definitions, skills whose frontmatter fails to parse); find unused skills, MCP servers, and plugins versus their context cost and disable dead weight; deduplicate local CLAUDE.md files against checked-in ones; trim checked-in CLAUDE.md files by cutting content a session could derive from the codebase (directory layouts, tech-stack lists, architecture overviews) while keeping gotchas, rationale, and non-standard conventions; migrate always-loaded CLAUDE.md guidance into lazy skills and nested CLAUDE.md files; flag slow hooks and context-heavy extensions; check the installed version is current; make auto mode the default permission mode; and pre-approve frequently denied read-only commands. Use when the user asks for a doctor run, checkup, audit, tune-up, or cleanup of their Claude Code setup or configuration.

commands.name: loop
commands.description: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace.

commands.name: docs
commands.description: docs (editable docs people share and comment on; the default for any document, named as a doc or not: a document, report, proposal, resume, cover letter, letter, contract, policy, form, template, worksheet, essay, handbook, guide, how-to, cheat sheet, SOP or other writing to keep, share, collaborate on, send, submit, print or sign; a doc exports to Word, PDF, Markdown or Google Docs, so needing a file to send, attach, upload, submit or print is no reason to pick Word, and a file nobody asked for is a doc, not Word; a plan, comparison, summary or notes asked in chat stays in chat; a pasted claude.ai artifact link may be a doc: check with docs tools first; Word or another file format named, tracked changes wanted, or a .docx to change or use as a template → that format's skill): making one → if no docs-connector instructions are in context, call its `guide` (topic.instructions) first; then create the doc (headings only, no body) before any search, file read or plan, even with files attached. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: google-workspace
commands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: computer-use
commands.description: Read this skill before the first step of any request to do something in an app on the person's own computer (Notes, Finder, System Settings, any desktop app), to look at their screen, or for "computer use". Computer use (desktop control) lets Claude take screenshots of the person's desktop and control it with clicks, typing and scrolling through the Claude desktop app; its tools are named mcp__computer-use__* when the session runs in the desktop app and mcp__remote-devices__computer_* when a cloud session is linked to the person's computer; before computer use is turned on for a conversation there may be no such tools, only an enable__mcp__remote-devices__computer tool, which turns it on. It covers turning it on, picking the right tool, the access flow, and the safety rules for tiered apps, links and financial actions. It is not for websites, which go through Claude in Chrome or the built-in browser and their own skills. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: chrome-browser
commands.description: Read this skill before the first step that uses Claude in Chrome, the browser extension whose tools are named mcp__claude-in-chrome__* (also called Chrome, the browser extension, or the external browser) and which acts in the person's real Chrome with their own sign-ins; before those tools are turned on there may be a single enable__mcp__claude-in-chrome tool instead. It covers loading the tools in one ToolSearch call, checking the person's open tabs and working in a new tab, site permissions, GIF recordings, console logs, dialogs to avoid, and when to stop and ask. It is not for the built-in browser (mcp__Claude_Browser__* or mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser__* tools), which has its own skill, and it does not decide which browser to use. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: built-in-browser
commands.description: Read this skill before the first step that uses the built-in browser, the browser pane inside the Claude desktop app (also called the in-app browser, the browser pane, Claude's browser, or "your own browser"), whose tools are named mcp__Claude_Browser__* when the session runs in the desktop app and mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser__* when a cloud session is linked to the person's computer; before those tools are turned on there may be a single enable__mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser tool instead. It covers the pane's persistent sign-ins, tabs and preview_start, reading pages as text, site approvals, what the pane cannot open, and what to do when it cannot be reached. It is not for Claude in Chrome (mcp__claude-in-chrome__* tools), which has its own skill, and it does not decide which browser to use. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: anthropic-skills:deep-research
commands.description: Use this skill when the user's prompt requires (1) researching a topic across multiple sources, comparing options or alternatives, analyzing trends or history, understanding markets or industries, or reviewing literature or studies and (2) synthesizing that research into a comprehensive, narrative report. If you're planning to search the web or internal knowledge bases, consider using this skill. This skill coordinates research subagents, so use it only when you have a tool for spawning subagents (the Agent or Task tool); otherwise, research the question directly. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: import-memory
commands.description: Import a memory export from another AI assistant into Claude's memory — conversationally, additively, and with the content treated as data. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: morning
commands.description: Render the user's morning brief as a styled HTML artifact, or set it up as a recurring weekday task. Use only when the user explicitly asks to run, see, or set up their morning brief, or if they invoke /morning by name. A question about their day, schedule, or calendar is not by itself a request for the brief; answer it directly instead. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: skill-creator
commands.description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: xlsx
commands.description: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like "the xlsx in my downloads") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: pptx
commands.description: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations as PowerPoint (.pptx) files; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email, summary, or creating a different type of slide deck); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user asks for a PowerPoint or .pptx file, or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. However, when the user asks for a deck, slides, a slide deck, or a presentation without naming a file format, default to using a dedicated slide-deck artifact type or a separate slides skill if this session offers one; otherwise, use this skill. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: pdf
commands.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: docx
commands.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx) or Word templates (.dotx). Triggers include: any mention of Microsoft Word Documents, such as 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', 'microsoft doc'. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a deliverable as a Word or .docx file (to download, email or print), use this skill. However, if they ask for a document, page, report, memo, or notes WITHOUT naming a file format and the session offers Claude's own dedicated document or page skill or connector, use that instead, even if they will email or print it. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or coding unrelated to document generation. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: schedule
commands.description: Create, update, list, or run scheduled cloud agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule.

commands.name: claude-api
commands.description:
Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).

commands.name: workflow-authoring
commands.description: Reference for writing a Workflow tool script (script API and gotchas, resume, quality patterns, worked examples). Load before authoring a script for a workflow the user already opted into; it does not itself authorize running one.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).

commands.name: run-skill-generator
commands.description: Author or improve the run-<unit> skill - a per-project skill that tells agents how to build, launch, and drive this project's app. Use when the user asks to set up the project, get it running, write run instructions, or verify build/run steps work from a clean environment.

commands.name: built-in-browser
commands.description: Read this skill before the first step that uses the built-in browser, the browser pane inside the Claude desktop app (also called the in-app browser, the browser pane, Claude's browser, or "your own browser"), whose tools are named mcp__Claude_Browser__* when the session runs in the desktop app and mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser__* when a cloud session is linked to the person's computer; before those tools are turned on there may be a single enable__mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser tool instead. It covers the pane's persistent sign-ins, tabs and preview_start, reading pages as text, site approvals, what the pane cannot open, and what to do when it cannot be reached. It is not for Claude in Chrome (mcp__claude-in-chrome__* tools), which has its own skill, and it does not decide which browser to use. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: chrome-browser
commands.description: Read this skill before the first step that uses Claude in Chrome, the browser extension whose tools are named mcp__claude-in-chrome__* (also called Chrome, the browser extension, or the external browser) and which acts in the person's real Chrome with their own sign-ins; before those tools are turned on there may be a single enable__mcp__claude-in-chrome tool instead. It covers loading the tools in one ToolSearch call, checking the person's open tabs and working in a new tab, site permissions, GIF recordings, console logs, dialogs to avoid, and when to stop and ask. It is not for the built-in browser (mcp__Claude_Browser__* or mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser__* tools), which has its own skill, and it does not decide which browser to use. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: computer-use
commands.description: Read this skill before the first step of any request to do something in an app on the person's own computer (Notes, Finder, System Settings, any desktop app), to look at their screen, or for "computer use". Computer use (desktop control) lets Claude take screenshots of the person's desktop and control it with clicks, typing and scrolling through the Claude desktop app; its tools are named mcp__computer-use__* when the session runs in the desktop app and mcp__remote-devices__computer_* when a cloud session is linked to the person's computer; before computer use is turned on for a conversation there may be no such tools, only an enable__mcp__remote-devices__computer tool, which turns it on. It covers turning it on, picking the right tool, the access flow, and the safety rules for tiered apps, links and financial actions. It is not for websites, which go through Claude in Chrome or the built-in browser and their own skills. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: anthropic-skills:deep-research
commands.description: Use this skill when the user's prompt requires (1) researching a topic across multiple sources, comparing options or alternatives, analyzing trends or history, understanding markets or industries, or reviewing literature or studies and (2) synthesizing that research into a comprehensive, narrative report. If you're planning to search the web or internal knowledge bases, consider using this skill. This skill coordinates research subagents, so use it only when you have a tool for spawning subagents (the Agent or Task tool); otherwise, research the question directly. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: docs
commands.description: docs (editable docs people share and comment on; the default for any document, named as a doc or not: a document, report, proposal, resume, cover letter, letter, contract, policy, form, template, worksheet, essay, handbook, guide, how-to, cheat sheet, SOP or other writing to keep, share, collaborate on, send, submit, print or sign; a doc exports to Word, PDF, Markdown or Google Docs, so needing a file to send, attach, upload, submit or print is no reason to pick Word, and a file nobody asked for is a doc, not Word; a plan, comparison, summary or notes asked in chat stays in chat; a pasted claude.ai artifact link may be a doc: check with docs tools first; Word or another file format named, tracked changes wanted, or a .docx to change or use as a template → that format's skill): making one → if no docs-connector instructions are in context, call its `guide` (topic.instructions) first; then create the doc (headings only, no body) before any search, file read or plan, even with files attached. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: docx
commands.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx) or Word templates (.dotx). Triggers include: any mention of Microsoft Word Documents, such as 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', 'microsoft doc'. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a deliverable as a Word or .docx file (to download, email or print), use this skill. However, if they ask for a document, page, report, memo, or notes WITHOUT naming a file format and the session offers Claude's own dedicated document or page skill or connector, use that instead, even if they will email or print it. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or coding unrelated to document generation. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: google-workspace
commands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: import-memory
commands.description: Import a memory export from another AI assistant into Claude's memory — conversationally, additively, and with the content treated as data. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: morning
commands.description: Render the user's morning brief as a styled HTML artifact, or set it up as a recurring weekday task. Use only when the user explicitly asks to run, see, or set up their morning brief, or if they invoke /morning by name. A question about their day, schedule, or calendar is not by itself a request for the brief; answer it directly instead. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: pdf
commands.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: pptx
commands.description: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations as PowerPoint (.pptx) files; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email, summary, or creating a different type of slide deck); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user asks for a PowerPoint or .pptx file, or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. However, when the user asks for a deck, slides, a slide deck, or a presentation without naming a file format, default to using a dedicated slide-deck artifact type or a separate slides skill if this session offers one; otherwise, use this skill. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: skill-creator
commands.description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: xlsx
commands.description: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like "the xlsx in my downloads") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved. (claude.ai sync)

# 질문: 즉시 구매는 어떻게 처리되나

구매자가 판매자가 올려 둔 판매 입찰 하나를 골라 "즉시 구매"를 요청한다. 배송지 ID, 창고 보관 여부, 결제 정보도 함께 보낸다.

이 요청이 서버에서 어떻게 처리되는지 코드를 읽고 답하라. 코드는 고치지 않는다.

1. 요청은 어느 API로 들어와 어떤 처리 단계를 거치나? 동기 처리인가, 비동기 처리인가? 응답으로 돌려주는 ID는 무엇의 ID인가?
2. 어떤 엔티티가 새로 만들어지고, 기존 엔티티의 상태는 어떤 순서로 바뀌나? 각 단계 직후의 상태 값을 적어라.
3. 결제 수단(카드, 계좌이체, 일반 결제)에 따라 결과가 어떻게 달라지나? 즉시 구매가 끝까지 성공하는지도 적어라. 결제 대행사가 카드 결제를 실패로 응답하면 어떻게 되나?
4. 누가 어떤 알림을 받나? 알림은 언제, 어떤 방식으로 전달되나?
5. 처리가 끝났을 때 주문의 최종 상태는 무엇인가? 구매자가 "창고 보관"을 선택한 경우 무엇이 달라지나?

주석이나 메서드 이름이 말하는 의도와 코드의 실제 동작이 다르면, 실제 동작을 답하라.

## 답 형식

저장소 루트에 `ANSWER.md`를 쓴다.

- 위 질문 번호별로 단계별 답을 쓴다.
- 각 단계에 근거를 `파일경로:줄`(예: `src/main/java/.../Foo.java:120`) 형식으로 붙인다. 근거 없는 주장은 점수를 받지 못한다.

1	# NAV — fream-back 코드 지도
2	
3	KREAM류 리셀 마켓. Spring Boot 3.4.1 / Java 17 / Gradle, JPA+QueryDSL(MySQL, test=H2), Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch, STOMP, Batch, OAuth2, PortOne, OpenAI.
4	- 루트 패키지: `src/main/java/com/fream/back/` (`FreamBackApplication.java`)
5	- `domain/<도메인>/` 19개 + `global/`(설정·보안·예외·유틸). 설정: `src/main/resources/application*.yml`
6	- 테스트: `src/test/.../FreamBackApplicationTests.java`(contextLoads) 1개
7	- 아래 경로는 `src/main/java/com/fream/back/` 기준 상대경로.
8	
9	## 공통 구조 (→ nav/conventions.md)
10	- 도메인 레이아웃: `controller/{command,query}`, `service/{command,query}`, `repository/`(QueryDSL은 `XxxRepositoryCustom`+`XxxRepositoryImpl`), `dto/`, `entity/`, `exception/`(`<D>ErrorCode` + `<D>Exception extends GlobalException`)
11	- 현재 사용자: `global/utils/SecurityUtils.extractEmailFromSecurityContext()`(principal은 email)
12	- 관리자 권한: URL 규칙이 아니라 코드에서 `domain/user/service/query/UserQueryService#checkAdminRole(email)`을 호출해 확인
13	- 예외 → `global/exception/GlobalExceptionHandler.java` → `global/response/ErrorResponse`
14	- 파일 업로드: `global/utils/FileUtils.saveFile`(루트 `/home/ubuntu/fream` 하드코딩)
15	- prod nginx가 `/api` 접두사를 떼고 넘기므로 컨트롤러 매핑에는 `/api`가 없음
16	
17	## 보안 / 인증 (→ nav/global.md, nav/user.md)
18	- `global/config/security/SecurityConfig.java` 필터 순서: IpBlocking → Login(`POST /auth/login`) → Logout → TokenRefresh(`POST /auth/refresh`) → `JwtAuthenticationFilter`
19	- JWT는 쿠키 `ACCESS_TOKEN`/`REFRESH_TOKEN`으로만 주고받고 Authorization 헤더는 읽지 않음. Redis 화이트리스트: `domain/user/redis/AuthRedisService.java`
20	- 화이트리스트 경로 외에는 모두 authenticated. hasRole 규칙 없음(authorities null)
21	- OAuth2(google/naver/kakao): `domain/user/security/oauth2/`
22	
23	## 도메인 일람
24	| 도메인 | 역할 | 주요 진입점 (`domain/` 기준) | 문서 |
25	|---|---|---|---|
26	| user | 회원·인증·프로필·팔로우/차단·계좌·포인트·등급·제재·관리자 | `user/controller/**`, `user/service/query/UserQueryService`, `user/entity/User` | nav/user.md |
27	| product | 상품/색상/사이즈·브랜드·카테고리·컬렉션·관심·ES 검색 | `product/controller/query/ProductQueryController`, `product/service/productColor/ProductColorCommandService`, `product/repository/ProductQueryDslRepository`, `product/elasticsearch/` | nav/product.md |
28	| order | 구매 입찰(OrderBid)·주문(Order/OrderItem) | `order/controller/{command,query}/Order*Controller`, `order/service/kafka/OrderEvent{Producer,Consumer}` | nav/order.md |
29	| sale | 판매 입찰(SaleBid)·판매(Sale)·판매 계좌 | `sale/controller/command/Sale*CommandController` | nav/sale.md |
30	| payment | 결제·결제수단(PaymentInfo)·PortOne | `payment/controller/command/PaymentInfoController`, `payment/portone/`, `payment/service/kafka/` | nav/payment.md |
31	| shipment | 구매자/판매자 배송·CJ 송장 추적 배치 | `shipment/controller/command/*ShipmentCommandController`, `global/config/ShipmentBatchScheduler` | nav/shipment.md |
32	| warehouseStorage | 창고 보관·보관 연장 | `warehouseStorage/controller/**` | nav/warehouseStorage.md |
33	| style | 스타일 피드·댓글·좋아요·해시태그·조회로그 | `style/controller/**`, `style/service/command/StyleCommandService`, `style/repository/StyleRepositoryCustomImpl` | nav/style.md |
34	| notification | 알림 저장 + STOMP 푸시 | `notification/service/command/NotificationCommandService`, `global/config/websocket/` | nav/notification.md |
35	| event | 브랜드 이벤트(+스케줄러, AOP) | `event/controller/**`, `event/scheduler/EventStatusScheduler` | nav/event.md |
36	| faq / inquiry / inspection / notice | CS 콘텐츠(FAQ, 1:1 문의, 검수기준, 공지) | 각 `controller/{command,query}` | nav/cs-content.md |
37	| chatQuestion | FAQ 기반 GPT 챗봇·사용량 로그 | `chatQuestion/controller/ChatController`, `global/config/GPTConfig` | nav/chatQuestion.md |
38	| address | 배송지(개인정보 암호화) | `address/controller/**` | nav/address.md |
39	| accessLog | 접속 로그(GeoIP, Kafka 선택) | `accessLog/controller/**` | nav/accessLog.md |
40	| weather | Open-Meteo 날씨 수집 | `weather/controller/WeatherQueryController` | nav/weather.md |
41	| monitoring | Kibana iframe 관리자 페이지 | `monitoring/controller/AdminMonitoringController` | nav/monitoring.md |
42	
43	## 도메인 간 의존 (import 기준)
44	- order → address, payment, product, sale, shipment, user, warehouseStorage
45	- sale → notification, order, payment, product, shipment, user
46	- payment → notification, order, sale, user / shipment → notification, order, sale, user, warehouseStorage
47	- warehouseStorage → order, sale, user / style → order, product, user / product → order, style, user
48	- user → address, notification, payment, product, style / notification → order, user
49	- event → product, user / notice → notification, user / chatQuestion → faq, user / faq·inquiry·inspection·address → user
50	- accessLog, weather, monitoring은 다른 도메인을 import하지 않음
51	
52	## 주요 흐름
53	- **거래**: 입찰(OrderBid/SaleBid) → Order 생성 → Kafka로 결제(PortOne)·배송 처리 → 판매자 발송 → 구매자 배송 또는 창고 보관. 검수 단계는 미구현 → `nav/flow-trade.md`
54	- **인증**: 로그인 필터 → JWT 쿠키 → Redis 화이트리스트 → `JwtAuthenticationFilter` → `nav/user.md`
55	- **알림**: 각 도메인 서비스가 `NotificationCommandService`를 호출 → DB 저장 → `/user/{email}/queue/notifications` 푸시 → `nav/notification.md`
56	- **조회 로그**: 상품/스타일 상세 → Kafka(아래 표) → 로그 저장
57	- **상품 검색**: QueryDSL(`/products/query`) 또는 ES(`/es/products`, 시작 시에만 재색인)
58	
59	## Kafka 토픽 (리스너 위치)
60	| 토픽 | 생산 | 소비(group) |
61	|---|---|---|
62	| order-processing-topic / order-retry-topic | `OrderEventProducer` | `OrderEventConsumer`(order-processing-group / order-retry-group) |
63	| payment-processing-topic / payment-retry-topic | `PaymentEventProducer`(processing 쪽은 호출처 없음) | `PaymentEventConsumer`(payment-processing-group / payment-retry-group) |
64	| user-access-log-topic | `UserAccessLogProducer` | `UserAccessLogConsumer` + `_backup`(같은 group) |
65	| view-log-topic | `ViewEventProducer` | `ViewEventConsumer` |
66	| style-view-log-topic | `StyleViewEventProducer` | `StyleViewEventConsumer`(style-view-group) |
67	| notification-topic | `OrderEventConsumer`가 전송 | **소비자 없음** |
68	
69	## 스케줄러
70	`EventStatusScheduler`·`PointExpirationScheduler`(매시), `global/config/ShipmentBatchScheduler`(6시간), `StyleViewLogBufferManager`(10초), `WeatherDataScheduler`(24시간), `AccessLogAopConfiguration`(10분), `FAQSearchOptimizationAspect`(1시간)
71	
72	## 함정 (상세는 각 문서)
73	- `application.yml`의 활성 프로필은 prod이고, prod는 `ddl-auto: create`. `global/config/DataInitializer`는 프로필 조건 없이 매번 시드 데이터를 넣음
74	- 만료 토큰 예외를 JWT 필터에서 잡지 않음. refresh 시 새 refresh 쿠키를 내려주지 않음
75	- ErrorResponse의 message는 항상 enum 기본 문구. 코드 `S001`이 security·sale·shipment에서 중복
76	- event/faq/address/chatQuestion의 커스텀 AOP 어노테이션은 적용처가 없음
77	- 이벤트 캐시 이름이 `CacheConfig`에 없음. order/sale의 `BidStatus` enum 중복. 입찰은 생성 즉시 MATCHED
78	
79	## nav/ 문서 목록
80	- `nav/conventions.md` — 컨벤션, 새 기능 체크리스트
81	- `nav/global.md` — global 패키지(보안·예외·Kafka/Redis/WebSocket/캐시·유틸)

file.content:
# NAV — fream-back 코드 지도

KREAM류 리셀 마켓. Spring Boot 3.4.1 / Java 17 / Gradle, JPA+QueryDSL(MySQL, test=H2), Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch, STOMP, Batch, OAuth2, PortOne, OpenAI.
- 루트 패키지: `src/main/java/com/fream/back/` (`FreamBackApplication.java`)
- `domain/<도메인>/` 19개 + `global/`(설정·보안·예외·유틸). 설정: `src/main/resources/application*.yml`
- 테스트: `src/test/.../FreamBackApplicationTests.java`(contextLoads) 1개
- 아래 경로는 `src/main/java/com/fream/back/` 기준 상대경로.

## 공통 구조 (→ nav/conventions.md)
- 도메인 레이아웃: `controller/{command,query}`, `service/{command,query}`, `repository/`(QueryDSL은 `XxxRepositoryCustom`+`XxxRepositoryImpl`), `dto/`, `entity/`, `exception/`(`<D>ErrorCode` + `<D>Exception extends GlobalException`)
- 현재 사용자: `global/utils/SecurityUtils.extractEmailFromSecurityContext()`(principal은 email)
- 관리자 권한: URL 규칙이 아니라 코드에서 `domain/user/service/query/UserQueryService#checkAdminRole(email)`을 호출해 확인
- 예외 → `global/exception/GlobalExceptionHandler.java` → `global/response/ErrorResponse`
- 파일 업로드: `global/utils/FileUtils.saveFile`(루트 `/home/ubuntu/fream` 하드코딩)
- prod nginx가 `/api` 접두사를 떼고 넘기므로 컨트롤러 매핑에는 `/api`가 없음

## 보안 / 인증 (→ nav/global.md, nav/user.md)
- `global/config/security/SecurityConfig.java` 필터 순서: IpBlocking → Login(`POST /auth/login`) → Logout → TokenRefresh(`POST /auth/refresh`) → `JwtAuthenticationFilter`
- JWT는 쿠키 `ACCESS_TOKEN`/`REFRESH_TOKEN`으로만 주고받고 Authorization 헤더는 읽지 않음. Redis 화이트리스트: `domain/user/redis/AuthRedisService.java`
- 화이트리스트 경로 외에는 모두 authenticated. hasRole 규칙 없음(authorities null)
- OAuth2(google/naver/kakao): `domain/user/security/oauth2/`

## 도메인 일람
| 도메인 | 역할 | 주요 진입점 (`domain/` 기준) | 문서 |
|---|---|---|---|
| user | 회원·인증·프로필·팔로우/차단·계좌·포인트·등급·제재·관리자 | `user/controller/**`, `user/service/query/UserQueryService`, `user/entity/User` | nav/user.md |
| product | 상품/색상/사이즈·브랜드·카테고리·컬렉션·관심·ES 검색 | `product/controller/query/ProductQueryController`, `product/service/productColor/ProductColorCommandService`, `product/repository/ProductQueryDslRepository`, `product/elasticsearch/` | nav/product.md |
| order | 구매 입찰(OrderBid)·주문(Order/OrderItem) | `order/controller/{command,query}/Order*Controller`, `order/service/kafka/OrderEvent{Producer,Consumer}` | nav/order.md |
| sale | 판매 입찰(SaleBid)·판매(Sale)·판매 계좌 | `sale/controller/command/Sale*CommandController` | nav/sale.md |
| payment | 결제·결제수단(PaymentInfo)·PortOne | `payment/controller/command/PaymentInfoController`, `payment/portone/`, `payment/service/kafka/` | nav/payment.md |
| shipment | 구매자/판매자 배송·CJ 송장 추적 배치 | `shipment/controller/command/*ShipmentCommandController`, `global/config/ShipmentBatchScheduler` | nav/shipment.md |
| warehouseStorage | 창고 보관·보관 연장 | `warehouseStorage/controller/**` | nav/warehouseStorage.md |
| style | 스타일 피드·댓글·좋아요·해시태그·조회로그 | `style/controller/**`, `style/service/command/StyleCommandService`, `style/repository/StyleRepositoryCustomImpl` | nav/style.md |
| notification | 알림 저장 + STOMP 푸시 | `notification/service/command/NotificationCommandService`, `global/config/websocket/` | nav/notification.md |
| event | 브랜드 이벤트(+스케줄러, AOP) | `event/controller/**`, `event/scheduler/EventStatusScheduler` | nav/event.md |
| faq / inquiry / inspection / notice | CS 콘텐츠(FAQ, 1:1 문의, 검수기준, 공지) | 각 `controller/{command,query}` | nav/cs-content.md |
| chatQuestion | FAQ 기반 GPT 챗봇·사용량 로그 | `chatQuestion/controller/ChatController`, `global/config/GPTConfig` | nav/chatQuestion.md |
| address | 배송지(개인정보 암호화) | `address/controller/**` | nav/address.md |
| accessLog | 접속 로그(GeoIP, Kafka 선택) | `accessLog/controller/**` | nav/accessLog.md |
| weather | Open-Meteo 날씨 수집 | `weather/controller/WeatherQueryController` | nav/weather.md |
| monitoring | Kibana iframe 관리자 페이지 | `monitoring/controller/AdminMonitoringController` | nav/monitoring.md |

## 도메인 간 의존 (import 기준)
- order → address, payment, product, sale, shipment, user, warehouseStorage
- sale → notification, order, payment, product, shipment, user
- payment → notification, order, sale, user / shipment → notification, order, sale, user, warehouseStorage
- warehouseStorage → order, sale, user / style → order, product, user / product → order, style, user
- user → address, notification, payment, product, style / notification → order, user
- event → product, user / notice → notification, user / chatQuestion → faq, user / faq·inquiry·inspection·address → user
- accessLog, weather, monitoring은 다른 도메인을 import하지 않음

## 주요 흐름
- **거래**: 입찰(OrderBid/SaleBid) → Order 생성 → Kafka로 결제(PortOne)·배송 처리 → 판매자 발송 → 구매자 배송 또는 창고 보관. 검수 단계는 미구현 → `nav/flow-trade.md`
- **인증**: 로그인 필터 → JWT 쿠키 → Redis 화이트리스트 → `JwtAuthenticationFilter` → `nav/user.md`
- **알림**: 각 도메인 서비스가 `NotificationCommandService`를 호출 → DB 저장 → `/user/{email}/queue/notifications` 푸시 → `nav/notification.md`
- **조회 로그**: 상품/스타일 상세 → Kafka(아래 표) → 로그 저장
- **상품 검색**: QueryDSL(`/products/query`) 또는 ES(`/es/products`, 시작 시에만 재색인)

## Kafka 토픽 (리스너 위치)
| 토픽 | 생산 | 소비(group) |
|---|---|---|
| order-processing-topic / order-retry-topic | `OrderEventProducer` | `OrderEventConsumer`(order-processing-group / order-retry-group) |
| payment-processing-topic / payment-retry-topic | `PaymentEventProducer`(processing 쪽은 호출처 없음) | `PaymentEventConsumer`(payment-processing-group / payment-retry-group) |
| user-access-log-topic | `UserAccessLogProducer` | `UserAccessLogConsumer` + `_backup`(같은 group) |
| view-log-topic | `ViewEventProducer` | `ViewEventConsumer` |
| style-view-log-topic | `StyleViewEventProducer` | `StyleViewEventConsumer`(style-view-group) |
| notification-topic | `OrderEventConsumer`가 전송 | **소비자 없음** |

## 스케줄러
`EventStatusScheduler`·`PointExpirationScheduler`(매시), `global/config/ShipmentBatchScheduler`(6시간), `StyleViewLogBufferManager`(10초), `WeatherDataScheduler`(24시간), `AccessLogAopConfiguration`(10분), `FAQSearchOptimizationAspect`(1시간)

## 함정 (상세는 각 문서)
- `application.yml`의 활성 프로필은 prod이고, prod는 `ddl-auto: create`. `global/config/DataInitializer`는 프로필 조건 없이 매번 시드 데이터를 넣음
- 만료 토큰 예외를 JWT 필터에서 잡지 않음. refresh 시 새 refresh 쿠키를 내려주지 않음
- ErrorResponse의 message는 항상 enum 기본 문구. 코드 `S001`이 security·sale·shipment에서 중복
- event/faq/address/chatQuestion의 커스텀 AOP 어노테이션은 적용처가 없음
- 이벤트 캐시 이름이 `CacheConfig`에 없음. order/sale의 `BidStatus` enum 중복. 입찰은 생성 즉시 MATCHED

## nav/ 문서 목록
- `nav/conventions.md` — 컨벤션, 새 기능 체크리스트
- `nav/global.md` — global 패키지(보안·예외·Kafka/Redis/WebSocket/캐시·유틸)
- `nav/infra.md` — 프로필·yml·docker·nginx·CI·빌드
- `nav/flow-trade.md` — 거래 흐름·상태 전이
- 도메인별 문서: 위 도메인 일람 표의 "문서" 열 참고

content.text: NAV.md는 읽었습니다. 거래 흐름 상세 문서와 관련 도메인 문서를 먼저 열겠습니다.

content.content:
1	# 거래(Trade) 교차 도메인 흐름
2	
3	> order / sale / payment / shipment / warehouseStorage 간 실제 호출 흐름. 경로 접두사 `src/main/java/com/fream/back/` 생략 시 `domain/...` 기준. 코드에서 확인된 사실만.
4	
5	## 1. 구매 입찰 → 주문 → 결제 → 배송/창고
6	1. `POST /order-bids` → `order/controller/command/OrderBidCommandController#createOrderBid` → `order/service/command/OrderBidCommandService#createOrderBid`
7	2. → `OrderCommandService#createOrderFromBid`: `OrderItemCommandService#createOrderItem` + **Order(PENDING_PAYMENT)** 저장
8	3. → OrderBid 저장, `OrderBid#assignOrder` 때문에 **status=MATCHED** (PENDING 아님)
9	4. 결제/배송지: `POST /orders/{orderId}/process-payment-shipment` → `OrderCommandController#processPaymentAndShipment` → `order/service/kafka/OrderEventProducer#sendOrderProcessingEvent` (topic `order-processing-topic`) → **202**
10	5. `OrderEventConsumer#handleOrderProcessingEvent` → `processCompleteOrder`:
11	   - `payment/service/command/PaymentCommandService#processPayment` (CARD면 `PortOneApiClient#processCardPayment`) → `Order#assignPayment`
12	   - `isSuccess` false면 실패 → retry 토픽 / 실패 알림
13	   - `shipment/.../OrderShipmentCommandService#createOrderShipment` (ShipmentStatus PENDING)
14	   - Order → PAYMENT_COMPLETED; 창고보관이면 `WarehouseStorageCommandService#createOrderStorage` + PREPARING→IN_WAREHOUSE→COMPLETED, 아니면 PREPARING
15	   - 성공 시 WebSocket(`/user/{email}/queue/notifications`, `/topic/order/{id}`) + `notification-topic` 발행(코드 내 consumer 없음)
16	6. 상태 확인: `GET /orders/{orderId}/status` (`OrderQueryController#getOrderStatus`)
17	
18	## 2. 즉시 구매 (기존 SaleBid 매칭)
19	`POST /order-bids/instant` → `OrderBidCommandController#createInstantOrderBid`(paymentRequest.userEmail 설정) → `OrderBidCommandService#createInstantOrderBid` → `SaleBidQueryService#findById` → `OrderCommandService#createInstantOrder`:
20	1. `AddressQueryService#getAddress` → Order(PENDING_PAYMENT) 저장 → paymentRequest.orderId 설정 → OrderItem
21	2. `OrderShipmentCommandService#createOrderShipment`(주소록 정보)
22	3. `SaleBid#assignOrder` + MATCHED, flush
23	4. Sale이 창고보관이면 `WarehouseStorageCommandService#updateWarehouseStatus(sale, ASSOCIATED_WITH_ORDER)`
24	5. `PaymentCommandService#processPayment` (동기) → `notifyUsersAndUpdateSaleStatus`: orderBid 아직 없음 → `SaleBidQueryService#findByOrderId` → 구매자/판매자 알림 + **Sale→SOLD**
25	6. 이후 OrderBid(MATCHED, isInstantPurchase, sale) 저장. **Order는 PENDING_PAYMENT 유지.** 응답 id는 OrderBid id.
26	
27	## 3. 판매 입찰 / 즉시 판매
28	- 판매 입찰: `POST /sale-bids` → `sale/controller/command/SaleBidCommandController#createSaleBid` → `SaleBidCommandService#createSaleBid` → `SaleCommandService#createSale`(Sale PENDING_SHIPMENT + `BankAccountQueryService#getBankAccount` → SaleBankAccount + 판매자 알림) → SaleBid 저장 → `Sale#assignSaleBid` (SaleBid **MATCHED**).
29	- 즉시 판매(OrderBid 매칭): `POST /sale-bids/instant` → `SaleBidCommandService#createInstantSaleBid` → `SaleCommandService#createInstantSale`(Sale PENDING_SHIPMENT, SaleBankAccount, `OrderBid#assignSale`+MATCHED, 구매자 알림) → SaleBid(MATCHED, order=orderBid.order) 저장. 결제/주문 상태는 변경 안 함 (구매자가 4번 결제 API 호출 시 `notifyUsersAndUpdateSaleStatus`가 Sale→SOLD).
30	
31	## 4. 결제 처리 / 실패 / 환불
32	- 유일한 결제 실행: `PaymentCommandService#processPayment` (호출: `OrderEventConsumer#processCompleteOrder`, `OrderCommandService#createInstantOrder`).
33	- 타입: CARD(PortOne `/subscribe/payments/onetime`, 저장 카드 복호화), ACCOUNT(`updateStatus(PENDING)`로 IllegalStateException 발생 → 실패), GENERAL(클라이언트 impUid 신뢰, PAID).
34	- 실패: 주문 Kafka 경로는 `OrderEventConsumer#handleOrderProcessingFailure` → `order-retry-topic`(최대 3회, sleep backoff) 또는 실패 알림. 트랜잭션 롤백으로 Order는 PENDING_PAYMENT 유지.
35	- Payment Kafka(`payment-processing-topic`/`payment-retry-topic`, `PaymentEventConsumer`)는 producer 호출처가 없어 사실상 미사용.
36	- 환불: `PaymentCommandService#refundPayment`(PortOne `/payments/cancel`) 존재하나 API/호출처 없음. Order REFUND_* 설정 코드 없음.
37	
38	## 5. 판매자 발송 → (검수) → 구매자 배송 → CJ 추적
39	1. 판매자 발송: `POST /sales/{saleId}/shipment` → `SaleCommandService#createSellerShipment` → `SellerShipmentCommandService#createSellerShipment`(SellerShipment IN_TRANSIT; 창고보관이면 `createSellerStorage` + Sale→IN_STORAGE) → `SaleCommandService#updateSaleStatus(IN_TRANSIT)` (창고보관이면 IN_STORAGE→IN_TRANSIT 불허로 실패). 대안 `POST /shipments/seller`는 Sale 상태를 IN_TRANSIT로 바꾸지 않음.
40	2. 검수: **구현 없음** (IN_INSPECTION/FAILED_INSPECTION 설정 코드 없음).
41	3. 구매자 송장 등록: `PATCH /shipments/order/{shipmentId}/status` → `OrderShipmentCommandService#updateTrackingInfo`: OrderShipment→IN_TRANSIT, `Order#updateStatus(IN_TRANSIT)`(PREPARING에서 불허 → 실패), 알림, `updateSaleStatusToSold`, 창고 SOLD, OrderBid/SaleBid→COMPLETED.
42	4. 수동 추적: `POST /shipments/order/{id}/check-status` → `updateAndCheckShipmentStatus` → `global/utils/CjTrackingPlaywright#getCurrentTrackingStatus` → DELIVERED면 `completeOrder`.
43	5. 배치: `global/config/ShipmentBatchScheduler#scheduleShipmentStatusJob`(cron `0 0 */6 * * *`) → `shipment/config/UpdateShipmentStatusesJobConfig` `updateShipmentStatusesJob` → `ShipmentItemProcessor#process`(PlaywrightBrowserManager 공유 브라우저) → DELIVERED: `OrderShipmentCommandService#completeOrder`(Order→COMPLETED, Sale→SOLD) + `NotificationCommandService#notifyShipmentCompleted`.
44	
45	## 6. 창고 보관 / 연장
46	- 구매 보관 생성: `OrderEventConsumer#processCompleteOrder` → `WarehouseStorageCommandService#createOrderStorage` (IN_STORAGE, +1개월).
47	- 판매자 보관 생성: `SellerShipmentCommandService#createSellerShipment` → `createSellerStorage`.
48	- 즉시구매 시 판매자 보관 → ASSOCIATED_WITH_ORDER; 구매자 송장 등록 시 → SOLD (`updateWarehouseStatusToSold`).
49	- 연장: `POST /warehouse-storage/commands/extend-period` → `WarehouseStorageCommandService#extendStoragePeriod` (newEndDate로 교체, 소유자·상태 검증). 만료 스케줄러 없음.
50	
51	## 7. 다른 도메인 호출
52	- notification `NotificationCommandService#createNotification`: SaleCommandService(판매입찰 등록/즉시판매), PaymentCommandService(결제완료/환불), OrderShipmentCommandService(출발/판매완료/주문완료), `notifyShipmentCompleted`(배치).
53	- WebSocket `SimpMessagingTemplate` + Kafka `notification-topic`: OrderEventConsumer.
54	- user: UserQueryService, BankAccountQueryService(정산계좌), PaymentInfo(User.paymentInfos). address: AddressQueryService. product: ProductSizeQueryService; product가 `OrderBidRepository#tradeCountByColorIds`(COMPLETED 수) 사용.
55	- **포인트**: Order.usedPoints는 0 고정, user 포인트 차감/적립 호출 없음.
56	
57	## 8. 상태 전이 표 (설정 위치)
58	**OrderStatus**
59	| 상태 | 설정 메서드 |
60	|---|---|
61	| PENDING_PAYMENT | `OrderCommandService#createOrderFromBid`, `#createInstantOrder` |
62	| PAYMENT_COMPLETED, PREPARING | `OrderEventConsumer#processCompleteOrder` (+ 미사용 `OrderCommandService#processPaymentAndShipment`) |
63	| IN_WAREHOUSE → COMPLETED | `OrderEventConsumer#processCompleteOrder` (창고보관) |
64	| IN_TRANSIT | `OrderShipmentCommandService#updateTrackingInfo` |
65	| COMPLETED | `OrderShipmentCommandService#completeOrder`, 미사용 `#updateShipmentStatuses` |
66	| SHIPMENT_STARTED, REFUND_REQUESTED, REFUNDED | 설정 코드 없음 |
67	
68	**SaleStatus**
69	| 상태 | 설정 메서드 |
70	|---|---|
71	| PENDING_SHIPMENT | `SaleCommandService#createSale`, `#createInstantSale` |
72	| IN_TRANSIT | `SaleCommandService#createSellerShipment` (→ updateSaleStatus) |
73	| IN_STORAGE | `SellerShipmentCommandService#createSellerShipment` (창고보관) |
74	| SOLD | `PaymentCommandService#notifyUsersAndUpdateSaleStatus`(검증 없음), `OrderShipmentCommandService#updateSaleStatusToSold` |
75	| IN_INSPECTION, FAILED_INSPECTION, ON_AUCTION, SELLING, AUCTION_EXPIRED | 없음 |
76	
77	**BidStatus (OrderBid / SaleBid)**
78	| 상태 | 설정 |
79	|---|---|
80	| MATCHED | `OrderBid#assignOrder/assignSale`, `SaleBid#assignSale/assignOrder`, `OrderCommandService#createInstantOrder`, `SaleCommandService#createInstantSale` |
81	| COMPLETED | `OrderShipmentCommandService#updateOrderAndSaleBidStatusToCompleted` (updateTrackingInfo에서) |
82	| PENDING (실질적으로 유지 안 됨), CANCELLED (없음) | |
83	
84	**ShipmentStatus (OrderShipment / SellerShipment)**
85	| 상태 | 설정 |
86	|---|---|
87	| PENDING | `OrderShipmentCommandService#createOrderShipment` |
88	| IN_TRANSIT | `OrderShipment/SellerShipment#updateTrackingInfo`, `SellerShipmentCommandService#createSellerShipment`, 배치/수동 체크 |
89	| OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED | `ShipmentItemProcessor#process`, `OrderShipmentCommandService#updateAndCheckShipmentStatus` |
90	
91	**PaymentStatus**: PAID(`createCardPayment` 성공 응답, `createGeneralPayment`), REFUNDED/REFUND_REQUESTED(`refundPayment`, 미호출).
92	
93	**WarehouseStatus**: IN_STORAGE(`createOrderStorage`, `createSellerStorage`), ASSOCIATED_WITH_ORDER(`OrderCommandService#createInstantOrder`), SOLD(`updateWarehouseStatusToSold`).

# 거래(Trade) 교차 도메인 흐름

> order / sale / payment / shipment / warehouseStorage 간 실제 호출 흐름. 경로 접두사 `src/main/java/com/fream/back/` 생략 시 `domain/...` 기준. 코드에서 확인된 사실만.

## 1. 구매 입찰 → 주문 → 결제 → 배송/창고
1. `POST /order-bids` → `order/controller/command/OrderBidCommandController#createOrderBid` → `order/service/command/OrderBidCommandService#createOrderBid`
2. → `OrderCommandService#createOrderFromBid`: `OrderItemCommandService#createOrderItem` + **Order(PENDING_PAYMENT)** 저장
3. → OrderBid 저장, `OrderBid#assignOrder` 때문에 **status=MATCHED** (PENDING 아님)
4. 결제/배송지: `POST /orders/{orderId}/process-payment-shipment` → `OrderCommandController#processPaymentAndShipment` → `order/service/kafka/OrderEventProducer#sendOrderProcessingEvent` (topic `order-processing-topic`) → **202**
5. `OrderEventConsumer#handleOrderProcessingEvent` → `processCompleteOrder`:
   - `payment/service/command/PaymentCommandService#processPayment` (CARD면 `PortOneApiClient#processCardPayment`) → `Order#assignPayment`
   - `isSuccess` false면 실패 → retry 토픽 / 실패 알림
   - `shipment/.../OrderShipmentCommandService#createOrderShipment` (ShipmentStatus PENDING)
   - Order → PAYMENT_COMPLETED; 창고보관이면 `WarehouseStorageCommandService#createOrderStorage` + PREPARING→IN_WAREHOUSE→COMPLETED, 아니면 PREPARING
   - 성공 시 WebSocket(`/user/{email}/queue/notifications`, `/topic/order/{id}`) + `notification-topic` 발행(코드 내 consumer 없음)
6. 상태 확인: `GET /orders/{orderId}/status` (`OrderQueryController#getOrderStatus`)

## 2. 즉시 구매 (기존 SaleBid 매칭)
`POST /order-bids/instant` → `OrderBidCommandController#createInstantOrderBid`(paymentRequest.userEmail 설정) → `OrderBidCommandService#createInstantOrderBid` → `SaleBidQueryService#findById` → `OrderCommandService#createInstantOrder`:
1. `AddressQueryService#getAddress` → Order(PENDING_PAYMENT) 저장 → paymentRequest.orderId 설정 → OrderItem
2. `OrderShipmentCommandService#createOrderShipment`(주소록 정보)
3. `SaleBid#assignOrder` + MATCHED, flush
4. Sale이 창고보관이면 `WarehouseStorageCommandService#updateWarehouseStatus(sale, ASSOCIATED_WITH_ORDER)`
5. `PaymentCommandService#processPayment` (동기) → `notifyUsersAndUpdateSaleStatus`: orderBid 아직 없음 → `SaleBidQueryService#findByOrderId` → 구매자/판매자 알림 + **Sale→SOLD**
6. 이후 OrderBid(MATCHED, isInstantPurchase, sale) 저장. **Order는 PENDING_PAYMENT 유지.** 응답 id는 OrderBid id.

## 3. 판매 입찰 / 즉시 판매
- 판매 입찰: `POST /sale-bids` → `sale/controller/command/SaleBidCommandController#createSaleBid` → `SaleBidCommandService#createSaleBid` → `SaleCommandService#createSale`(Sale PENDING_SHIPMENT + `BankAccountQueryService#getBankAccount` → SaleBankAccount + 판매자 알림) → SaleBid 저장 → `Sale#assignSaleBid` (SaleBid **MATCHED**).
- 즉시 판매(OrderBid 매칭): `POST /sale-bids/instant` → `SaleBidCommandService#createInstantSaleBid` → `SaleCommandService#createInstantSale`(Sale PENDING_SHIPMENT, SaleBankAccount, `OrderBid#assignSale`+MATCHED, 구매자 알림) → SaleBid(MATCHED, order=orderBid.order) 저장. 결제/주문 상태는 변경 안 함 (구매자가 4번 결제 API 호출 시 `notifyUsersAndUpdateSaleStatus`가 Sale→SOLD).

## 4. 결제 처리 / 실패 / 환불
- 유일한 결제 실행: `PaymentCommandService#processPayment` (호출: `OrderEventConsumer#processCompleteOrder`, `OrderCommandService#createInstantOrder`).
- 타입: CARD(PortOne `/subscribe/payments/onetime`, 저장 카드 복호화), ACCOUNT(`updateStatus(PENDING)`로 IllegalStateException 발생 → 실패), GENERAL(클라이언트 impUid 신뢰, PAID).
- 실패: 주문 Kafka 경로는 `OrderEventConsumer#handleOrderProcessingFailure` → `order-retry-topic`(최대 3회, sleep backoff) 또는 실패 알림. 트랜잭션 롤백으로 Order는 PENDING_PAYMENT 유지.
- Payment Kafka(`payment-processing-topic`/`payment-retry-topic`, `PaymentEventConsumer`)는 producer 호출처가 없어 사실상 미사용.
- 환불: `PaymentCommandService#refundPayment`(PortOne `/payments/cancel`) 존재하나 API/호출처 없음. Order REFUND_* 설정 코드 없음.

## 5. 판매자 발송 → (검수) → 구매자 배송 → CJ 추적
1. 판매자 발송: `POST /sales/{saleId}/shipment` → `SaleCommandService#createSellerShipment` → `SellerShipmentCommandService#createSellerShipment`(SellerShipment IN_TRANSIT; 창고보관이면 `createSellerStorage` + Sale→IN_STORAGE) → `SaleCommandService#updateSaleStatus(IN_TRANSIT)` (창고보관이면 IN_STORAGE→IN_TRANSIT 불허로 실패). 대안 `POST /shipments/seller`는 Sale 상태를 IN_TRANSIT로 바꾸지 않음.
2. 검수: **구현 없음** (IN_INSPECTION/FAILED_INSPECTION 설정 코드 없음).
3. 구매자 송장 등록: `PATCH /shipments/order/{shipmentId}/status` → `OrderShipmentCommandService#updateTrackingInfo`: OrderShipment→IN_TRANSIT, `Order#updateStatus(IN_TRANSIT)`(PREPARING에서 불허 → 실패), 알림, `updateSaleStatusToSold`, 창고 SOLD, OrderBid/SaleBid→COMPLETED.
4. 수동 추적: `POST /shipments/order/{id}/check-status` → `updateAndCheckShipmentStatus` → `global/utils/CjTrackingPlaywright#getCurrentTrackingStatus` → DELIVERED면 `completeOrder`.
5. 배치: `global/config/ShipmentBatchScheduler#scheduleShipmentStatusJob`(cron `0 0 */6 * * *`) → `shipment/config/UpdateShipmentStatusesJobConfig` `updateShipmentStatusesJob` → `ShipmentItemProcessor#process`(PlaywrightBrowserManager 공유 브라우저) → DELIVERED: `OrderShipmentCommandService#completeOrder`(Order→COMPLETED, Sale→SOLD) + `NotificationCommandService#notifyShipmentCompleted`.

## 6. 창고 보관 / 연장
- 구매 보관 생성: `OrderEventConsumer#processCompleteOrder` → `WarehouseStorageCommandService#createOrderStorage` (IN_STORAGE, +1개월).
- 판매자 보관 생성: `SellerShipmentCommandService#createSellerShipment` → `createSellerStorage`.
- 즉시구매 시 판매자 보관 → ASSOCIATED_WITH_ORDER; 구매자 송장 등록 시 → SOLD (`updateWarehouseStatusToSold`).
- 연장: `POST /warehouse-storage/commands/extend-period` → `WarehouseStorageCommandService#extendStoragePeriod` (newEndDate로 교체, 소유자·상태 검증). 만료 스케줄러 없음.

## 7. 다른 도메인 호출
- notification `NotificationCommandService#createNotification`: SaleCommandService(판매입찰 등록/즉시판매), PaymentCommandService(결제완료/환불), OrderShipmentCommandService(출발/판매완료/주문완료), `notifyShipmentCompleted`(배치).
- WebSocket `SimpMessagingTemplate` + Kafka `notification-topic`: OrderEventConsumer.
- user: UserQueryService, BankAccountQueryService(정산계좌), PaymentInfo(User.paymentInfos). address: AddressQueryService. product: ProductSizeQueryService; product가 `OrderBidRepository#tradeCountByColorIds`(COMPLETED 수) 사용.
- **포인트**: Order.usedPoints는 0 고정, user 포인트 차감/적립 호출 없음.

## 8. 상태 전이 표 (설정 위치)
**OrderStatus**
| 상태 | 설정 메서드 |
|---|---|
| PENDING_PAYMENT | `OrderCommandService#createOrderFromBid`, `#createInstantOrder` |
| PAYMENT_COMPLETED, PREPARING | `OrderEventConsumer#processCompleteOrder` (+ 미사용 `OrderCommandService#processPaymentAndShipment`) |
| IN_WAREHOUSE → COMPLETED | `OrderEventConsumer#processCompleteOrder` (창고보관) |
| IN_TRANSIT | `OrderShipmentCommandService#updateTrackingInfo` |
| COMPLETED | `OrderShipmentCommandService#completeOrder`, 미사용 `#updateShipmentStatuses` |
| SHIPMENT_STARTED, REFUND_REQUESTED, REFUNDED | 설정 코드 없음 |

**SaleStatus**
| 상태 | 설정 메서드 |
|---|---|
| PENDING_SHIPMENT | `SaleCommandService#createSale`, `#createInstantSale` |
| IN_TRANSIT | `SaleCommandService#createSellerShipment` (→ updateSaleStatus) |
| IN_STORAGE | `SellerShipmentCommandService#createSellerShipment` (창고보관) |
| SOLD | `PaymentCommandService#notifyUsersAndUpdateSaleStatus`(검증 없음), `OrderShipmentCommandService#updateSaleStatusToSold` |
| IN_INSPECTION, FAILED_INSPECTION, ON_AUCTION, SELLING, AUCTION_EXPIRED | 없음 |

**BidStatus (OrderBid / SaleBid)**
| 상태 | 설정 |
|---|---|
| MATCHED | `OrderBid#assignOrder/assignSale`, `SaleBid#assignSale/assignOrder`, `OrderCommandService#createInstantOrder`, `SaleCommandService#createInstantSale` |
| COMPLETED | `OrderShipmentCommandService#updateOrderAndSaleBidStatusToCompleted` (updateTrackingInfo에서) |
| PENDING (실질적으로 유지 안 됨), CANCELLED (없음) | |

**ShipmentStatus (OrderShipment / SellerShipment)**
| 상태 | 설정 |
|---|---|
| PENDING | `OrderShipmentCommandService#createOrderShipment` |
| IN_TRANSIT | `OrderShipment/SellerShipment#updateTrackingInfo`, `SellerShipmentCommandService#createSellerShipment`, 배치/수동 체크 |
| OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED | `ShipmentItemProcessor#process`, `OrderShipmentCommandService#updateAndCheckShipmentStatus` |

**PaymentStatus**: PAID(`createCardPayment` 성공 응답, `createGeneralPayment`), REFUNDED/REFUND_REQUESTED(`refundPayment`, 미호출).

**WarehouseStatus**: IN_STORAGE(`createOrderStorage`, `createSellerStorage`), ASSOCIATED_WITH_ORDER(`OrderCommandService#createInstantOrder`), SOLD(`updateWarehouseStatusToSold`).

1	# order 도메인 네비게이션 맵
2	
3	> 기준 경로: `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/order` (54 files). 코드에서 확인된 사실만 기재. 교차 흐름은 `nav/flow-trade.md` 참고.
4	
5	## 1. 개요
6	- 구매 측 거래 도메인: **구매 입찰(OrderBid)**, **주문(Order)**, **주문 항목(OrderItem)**.
7	- 일반 구매 입찰 생성 시 `Order(PENDING_PAYMENT)`가 즉시 함께 생성되고, 결제/배송지 입력은 `POST /orders/{orderId}/process-payment-shipment` → **Kafka(`order-processing-topic`) 비동기** 처리.
8	- 즉시 구매(`POST /order-bids/instant`)는 기존 SaleBid에 매칭 + 결제를 **동기**로 한 트랜잭션에서 처리.
9	- 결제는 payment, 배송은 shipment, 창고보관은 warehouseStorage 도메인 서비스 호출.
10	
11	## 2. 패키지/파일 구조
12	```
13	src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/order/
14	├── controller/command/ OrderBidCommandController.java (/order-bids), OrderCommandController.java (/orders)
15	├── controller/query/   OrderBidQueryController.java (/order-bids), OrderQueryController.java (/orders, OrderRepository 직접 사용)
16	├── dto/ InstantOrderRequestDto, OrderBidRequestDto, OrderBidResponseDto, OrderBidStatusCountDto, PayAndShipmentRequestDto
17	├── dto/kafka/OrderProcessingEvent.java
18	├── entity/ Order, OrderBid, OrderItem, OrderStatus, BidStatus
19	├── exception/ OrderErrorCode, OrderException + 25개 하위 예외 (SaleBidNotFoundException, ProductSizeNotFoundException 포함)
20	├── repository/ OrderRepository, OrderBidRepository(+Custom, Impl=QueryDSL), OrderItemRepository
21	└── service/
22	    ├── command/ OrderBidCommandService, OrderCommandService, OrderItemCommandService
23	    ├── kafka/   OrderEventProducer, OrderEventConsumer
24	    └── query/   OrderBidQueryService, OrderItemQueryService
25	```
26	관련 global: `src/main/java/com/fream/back/global/config/kafka/OrderKafkaConfig.java`, `src/main/java/com/fream/back/global/utils/SecurityUtils.java` (`extractAndValidateEmailForOrderBid`, `extractAndValidateEmailForOrder`).
27	
28	## 3. 엔티티
29	| 엔티티 (테이블) | 주요 필드 | 관계 |
30	|---|---|---|
31	| `Order` (`orders`) extends BaseTimeEntity | totalAmount, discountAmount, usedPoints(int), status(OrderStatus) | user(ManyToOne `User`), payment(1:1 mappedBy, `Payment`), orderShipment(1:1 mappedBy, `OrderShipment`), warehouseStorage(1:1 mappedBy, `WarehouseStorage`), orderItems(1:N), orderBid(1:1 mappedBy) — 모두 cascade ALL + orphanRemoval |
32	| `OrderBid` | bidPrice, status(order.entity.BidStatus, 기본 PENDING), isInstantPurchase | user, productSize(`ProductSize`), order(1:1 FK order_id), sale(1:1 FK sale_id, `sale.entity.Sale`) |
33	| `OrderItem` | quantity(항상 1), price | order(ManyToOne), productSize(ManyToOne). style 도메인 `StyleOrderItem`이 참조 |
34	
35	**OrderStatus** (`entity/OrderStatus.java`, `canTransitionTo` 맵 기반):
36	| from | 허용 to |
37	|---|---|
38	| PENDING_PAYMENT | PAYMENT_COMPLETED, COMPLETED, IN_WAREHOUSE |
39	| PAYMENT_COMPLETED | PREPARING, REFUND_REQUESTED, IN_WAREHOUSE |
40	| PREPARING | IN_WAREHOUSE, SHIPMENT_STARTED |
41	| IN_WAREHOUSE | SHIPMENT_STARTED, COMPLETED |
42	| SHIPMENT_STARTED | IN_TRANSIT |
43	| IN_TRANSIT | COMPLETED |
44	| REFUND_REQUESTED | REFUNDED |
45	| COMPLETED / REFUNDED | (없음) |
46	
47	**BidStatus** (`order/entity/BidStatus.java`): PENDING, MATCHED, CANCELLED, COMPLETED. (sale 도메인에 동일 이름·동일 값의 별도 enum 존재)
48	
49	상태 변경 메서드:
50	- `Order#updateStatus(OrderStatus)` (Order.java:113): status==null 이거나 `canTransitionTo` 통과 시만 변경, 아니면 `InvalidOrderStatusException`.
51	- `OrderBid#assignOrder(Order)` (OrderBid.java:60): order != null이면 **status=MATCHED** 로 설정 + 양방향 연결.
52	- `OrderBid#assignSale(Sale)` (:89): status=MATCHED. `OrderBid#updateStatus` (:106): 검증 없이 대입. `markAsInstantPurchase()`.
53	- 연관 편의: `Order#assignPayment/assignOrderShipment/assignWarehouseStorage/assignOrderBid/addOrderItem`.
54	
55	## 4. API 엔드포인트
56	SecurityConfig: 화이트리스트 외 `anyRequest().authenticated()` → 아래 전부 인증 필요. 이메일은 SecurityContext에서 추출.
57	
58	| Method | Path | Controller#method | Service | 비고 |
59	|---|---|---|---|---|
60	| POST | /order-bids | OrderBidCommandController#createOrderBid | OrderBidCommandService#createOrderBid | body `OrderBidRequestDto`(productSizeId, bidPrice). 응답 OrderBid id |
61	| DELETE | /order-bids/{orderBidId} | OrderBidCommandController#deleteOrderBid | OrderBidCommandService#deleteOrderBid | 소유자 검증 없음 (email은 로그용) |
62	| POST | /order-bids/instant | OrderBidCommandController#createInstantOrderBid | OrderBidCommandService#createInstantOrderBid | body `InstantOrderRequestDto`(saleBidId, addressId, warehouseStorage, paymentRequest). `enrichPaymentRequest`가 userEmail 설정. 응답은 **OrderBid id**(변수명 orderId) |
63	| GET | /order-bids?bidStatus&orderStatus&page | OrderBidQueryController#getOrderBids | OrderBidQueryService#getOrderBids → `findOrderBidsByFilters` | |
64	| GET | /order-bids/count | OrderBidQueryController#getOrderBidStatusCounts | OrderBidQueryService#getOrderBidStatusCounts | |
65	| GET | /order-bids/{orderBidId} | OrderBidQueryController#getOrderBidDetail | OrderBidQueryService#getOrderBidDetail | 본인 것만(email 조건) |
66	| POST | /orders/{orderId}/process-payment-shipment | OrderCommandController#processPaymentAndShipment | OrderEventProducer#sendOrderProcessingEvent (Kafka) | **202 Accepted** 즉시 반환, websocketTopic `/topic/order/{orderId}` 안내 |
67	| POST | /orders/{orderId}/cancel | OrderCommandController#cancelOrderProcessing | (없음) | TODO 스텁: 항상 CANCELLED 응답, 실제 처리 없음 |
68	| GET | /orders/{orderId}/status | OrderQueryController#getOrderStatus | OrderRepository#findById 직접 | 소유자 아니면 403 |
69	| GET | /orders/{orderId} | OrderQueryController#getOrderDetails | OrderRepository#findById 직접 | |
70	| GET | /orders?page&size&status | OrderQueryController#getUserOrders | (없음) | TODO 스텁: 항상 빈 목록 |
71	
72	## 5. 서비스 계층
73	- **OrderBidCommandService**
74	  - `createOrderBid(email, productSizeId, bidPrice)` (:47): UserQueryService#findByEmail → ProductSizeQueryService#findById → `OrderCommandService#createOrderFromBid` → OrderBid 빌드 후 `assignOrder(order)` → 저장.
75	  - `createInstantOrderBid(buyerEmail, saleBidId, addressId, isWarehouseStorage, paymentRequest)` (:119): `SaleBidQueryService#findById` → `OrderCommandService#createInstantOrder` → OrderBid(MATCHED, sale 지정, isInstantPurchase=true) 저장.
76	  - `matchOrderBid(OrderBid)` (:228): 호출처 없음.
77	  - `deleteOrderBid(orderBidId)` (:257): sale 연결 또는 MATCHED면 `OrderBidAlreadyMatchedException`; order 있으면 `OrderCommandService#deleteOrder` 후 삭제.
78	- **OrderCommandService**
79	  - `createOrderFromBid(user, productSize, bidPrice)` (:59): `OrderItemCommandService#createOrderItem` + Order(PENDING_PAYMENT, totalAmount=bidPrice) 저장.
80	  - `createInstantOrder(...)` (:220): `AddressQueryService#getAddress` → Order(PENDING_PAYMENT) 저장 → `paymentRequest.setOrderId` → OrderItem → `OrderShipmentCommandService#createOrderShipment`(주소록 정보) → `saleBid.assignOrder(order)`+MATCHED, `entityManager.flush()` → sale.isWarehouseStorage면 `WarehouseStorageCommandService#updateWarehouseStatus(sale, ASSOCIATED_WITH_ORDER)` → `PaymentCommandService#processPayment`. **Order 상태는 PENDING_PAYMENT 그대로 유지, `order.assignPayment` 미호출.**
81	  - `processPaymentAndShipment(...)` (:112): 동기 버전. 컨트롤러 호출은 주석 처리되어 현재 **호출처 없음**.
82	  - `deleteOrder(orderId)` (:328).
83	- **OrderItemCommandService#createOrderItem(order, productSize, price)**: quantity=1.
84	- **OrderEventProducer** (`service/kafka`): `sendOrderProcessingEvent` → `order-processing-topic` (key=orderId), `sendOrderRetryEvent` → `order-retry-topic` (retryCount≥3이면 중단), `sendOrderProcessingEventSync`(호출처 없음).
85	- **OrderEventConsumer**: 아래 7절.
86	- **OrderBidQueryService**: `findById`, `findByOrderId`, `getOrderBids`, `getOrderBidStatusCounts`, `getOrderBidDetail`. **OrderItemQueryService#findById** (style 도메인에서 사용).
87	
88	## 6. Repositories
89	- `OrderRepository`: `findByUser_EmailAndStatus`, `findByUserAndStatus`.
90	- `OrderBidRepository`: `findByOrderId`. Custom(`OrderBidRepositoryImpl`, QueryDSL):
91	  - `findOrderBidsByFilters(email, bidStatus, orderStatus, pageable)`: orderBid ⨝ user/productSize/productColor/product/thumbnailImage, leftJoin order/orderShipment → `OrderBidResponseDto` projection.
92	  - `countOrderBidsByStatus(email)`: PENDING / MATCHED / (CANCELLED+COMPLETED) 개수.
93	  - `findOrderBidById(orderBidId, email)`.
94	  - `tradeCountByColorIds(colorIds)`: status=COMPLETED OrderBid를 productColor별 count → product 도메인 `ProductQueryService`, `ProductColorSearchService`가 사용.
95	- `OrderItemRepository`: `findByOrder_Id`, `findByProductSize`, `findByQuantityGreaterThan`, `findByOrderIn`.

99	| 토픽 | Producer | Consumer (groupId, containerFactory) |

120	
121	## 9. 예외
122	- `OrderException extends GlobalException`, `OrderErrorCode implements ErrorCode`, 코드 prefix **ORD**:
123	  ORD001~008(주문: NOT_FOUND, CREATION/UPDATE/DELETION_FAILED, PAYMENT/SHIPMENT_PROCESSING_FAILED, STATUS_UPDATE_FAILED, INVALID_ORDER_STATUS), ORD101~108(입찰), ORD201~202(항목), ORD301~302(접근권한), ORD401~404(입력값), ORD501 PRODUCT_SIZE_NOT_FOUND, ORD502 SALE_BID_NOT_FOUND, ORD503 WAREHOUSE_STORAGE_PROCESSING_FAILED.

126	## 10. 작업 팁 / 주의점

# order 도메인 네비게이션 맵

> 기준 경로: `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/order` (54 files). 코드에서 확인된 사실만 기재. 교차 흐름은 `nav/flow-trade.md` 참고.

## 1. 개요
- 구매 측 거래 도메인: **구매 입찰(OrderBid)**, **주문(Order)**, **주문 항목(OrderItem)**.
- 일반 구매 입찰 생성 시 `Order(PENDING_PAYMENT)`가 즉시 함께 생성되고, 결제/배송지 입력은 `POST /orders/{orderId}/process-payment-shipment` → **Kafka(`order-processing-topic`) 비동기** 처리.
- 즉시 구매(`POST /order-bids/instant`)는 기존 SaleBid에 매칭 + 결제를 **동기**로 한 트랜잭션에서 처리.
- 결제는 payment, 배송은 shipment, 창고보관은 warehouseStorage 도메인 서비스 호출.

## 2. 패키지/파일 구조
```
src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/order/
├── controller/command/ OrderBidCommandController.java (/order-bids), OrderCommandController.java (/orders)
├── controller/query/   OrderBidQueryController.java (/order-bids), OrderQueryController.java (/orders, OrderRepository 직접 사용)
├── dto/ InstantOrderRequestDto, OrderBidRequestDto, OrderBidResponseDto, OrderBidStatusCountDto, PayAndShipmentRequestDto
├── dto/kafka/OrderProcessingEvent.java
├── entity/ Order, OrderBid, OrderItem, OrderStatus, BidStatus
├── exception/ OrderErrorCode, OrderException + 25개 하위 예외 (SaleBidNotFoundException, ProductSizeNotFoundException 포함)
├── repository/ OrderRepository, OrderBidRepository(+Custom, Impl=QueryDSL), OrderItemRepository
└── service/
    ├── command/ OrderBidCommandService, OrderCommandService, OrderItemCommandService
    ├── kafka/   OrderEventProducer, OrderEventConsumer
    └── query/   OrderBidQueryService, OrderItemQueryService
```
관련 global: `src/main/java/com/fream/back/global/config/kafka/OrderKafkaConfig.java`, `src/main/java/com/fream/back/global/utils/SecurityUtils.java` (`extractAndValidateEmailForOrderBid`, `extractAndValidateEmailForOrder`).

## 3. 엔티티
| 엔티티 (테이블) | 주요 필드 | 관계 |
|---|---|---|
| `Order` (`orders`) extends BaseTimeEntity | totalAmount, discountAmount, usedPoints(int), status(OrderStatus) | user(ManyToOne `User`), payment(1:1 mappedBy, `Payment`), orderShipment(1:1 mappedBy, `OrderShipment`), warehouseStorage(1:1 mappedBy, `WarehouseStorage`), orderItems(1:N), orderBid(1:1 mappedBy) — 모두 cascade ALL + orphanRemoval |
| `OrderBid` | bidPrice, status(order.entity.BidStatus, 기본 PENDING), isInstantPurchase | user, productSize(`ProductSize`), order(1:1 FK order_id), sale(1:1 FK sale_id, `sale.entity.Sale`) |
| `OrderItem` | quantity(항상 1), price | order(ManyToOne), productSize(ManyToOne). style 도메인 `StyleOrderItem`이 참조 |

**OrderStatus** (`entity/OrderStatus.java`, `canTransitionTo` 맵 기반):
| from | 허용 to |
|---|---|
| PENDING_PAYMENT | PAYMENT_COMPLETED, COMPLETED, IN_WAREHOUSE |
| PAYMENT_COMPLETED | PREPARING, REFUND_REQUESTED, IN_WAREHOUSE |
| PREPARING | IN_WAREHOUSE, SHIPMENT_STARTED |
| IN_WAREHOUSE | SHIPMENT_STARTED, COMPLETED |
| SHIPMENT_STARTED | IN_TRANSIT |
| IN_TRANSIT | COMPLETED |
| REFUND_REQUESTED | REFUNDED |
| COMPLETED / REFUNDED | (없음) |

**BidStatus** (`order/entity/BidStatus.java`): PENDING, MATCHED, CANCELLED, COMPLETED. (sale 도메인에 동일 이름·동일 값의 별도 enum 존재)

상태 변경 메서드:
- `Order#updateStatus(OrderStatus)` (Order.java:113): status==null 이거나 `canTransitionTo` 통과 시만 변경, 아니면 `InvalidOrderStatusException`.
- `OrderBid#assignOrder(Order)` (OrderBid.java:60): order != null이면 **status=MATCHED** 로 설정 + 양방향 연결.
- `OrderBid#assignSale(Sale)` (:89): status=MATCHED. `OrderBid#updateStatus` (:106): 검증 없이 대입. `markAsInstantPurchase()`.
- 연관 편의: `Order#assignPayment/assignOrderShipment/assignWarehouseStorage/assignOrderBid/addOrderItem`.

## 4. API 엔드포인트
SecurityConfig: 화이트리스트 외 `anyRequest().authenticated()` → 아래 전부 인증 필요. 이메일은 SecurityContext에서 추출.

| Method | Path | Controller#method | Service | 비고 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | /order-bids | OrderBidCommandController#createOrderBid | OrderBidCommandService#createOrderBid | body `OrderBidRequestDto`(productSizeId, bidPrice). 응답 OrderBid id |
| DELETE | /order-bids/{orderBidId} | OrderBidCommandController#deleteOrderBid | OrderBidCommandService#deleteOrderBid | 소유자 검증 없음 (email은 로그용) |
| POST | /order-bids/instant | OrderBidCommandController#createInstantOrderBid | OrderBidCommandService#createInstantOrderBid | body `InstantOrderRequestDto`(saleBidId, addressId, warehouseStorage, paymentRequest). `enrichPaymentRequest`가 userEmail 설정. 응답은 **OrderBid id**(변수명 orderId) |
| GET | /order-bids?bidStatus&orderStatus&page | OrderBidQueryController#getOrderBids | OrderBidQueryService#getOrderBids → `findOrderBidsByFilters` | |
| GET | /order-bids/count | OrderBidQueryController#getOrderBidStatusCounts | OrderBidQueryService#getOrderBidStatusCounts | |
| GET | /order-bids/{orderBidId} | OrderBidQueryController#getOrderBidDetail | OrderBidQueryService#getOrderBidDetail | 본인 것만(email 조건) |
| POST | /orders/{orderId}/process-payment-shipment | OrderCommandController#processPaymentAndShipment | OrderEventProducer#sendOrderProcessingEvent (Kafka) | **202 Accepted** 즉시 반환, websocketTopic `/topic/order/{orderId}` 안내 |
| POST | /orders/{orderId}/cancel | OrderCommandController#cancelOrderProcessing | (없음) | TODO 스텁: 항상 CANCELLED 응답, 실제 처리 없음 |
| GET | /orders/{orderId}/status | OrderQueryController#getOrderStatus | OrderRepository#findById 직접 | 소유자 아니면 403 |
| GET | /orders/{orderId} | OrderQueryController#getOrderDetails | OrderRepository#findById 직접 | |
| GET | /orders?page&size&status | OrderQueryController#getUserOrders | (없음) | TODO 스텁: 항상 빈 목록 |

## 5. 서비스 계층
- **OrderBidCommandService**
  - `createOrderBid(email, productSizeId, bidPrice)` (:47): UserQueryService#findByEmail → ProductSizeQueryService#findById → `OrderCommandService#createOrderFromBid` → OrderBid 빌드 후 `assignOrder(order)` → 저장.
  - `createInstantOrderBid(buyerEmail, saleBidId, addressId, isWarehouseStorage, paymentRequest)` (:119): `SaleBidQueryService#findById` → `OrderCommandService#createInstantOrder` → OrderBid(MATCHED, sale 지정, isInstantPurchase=true) 저장.
  - `matchOrderBid(OrderBid)` (:228): 호출처 없음.
  - `deleteOrderBid(orderBidId)` (:257): sale 연결 또는 MATCHED면 `OrderBidAlreadyMatchedException`; order 있으면 `OrderCommandService#deleteOrder` 후 삭제.
- **OrderCommandService**
  - `createOrderFromBid(user, productSize, bidPrice)` (:59): `OrderItemCommandService#createOrderItem` + Order(PENDING_PAYMENT, totalAmount=bidPrice) 저장.
  - `createInstantOrder(...)` (:220): `AddressQueryService#getAddress` → Order(PENDING_PAYMENT) 저장 → `paymentRequest.setOrderId` → OrderItem → `OrderShipmentCommandService#createOrderShipment`(주소록 정보) → `saleBid.assignOrder(order)`+MATCHED, `entityManager.flush()` → sale.isWarehouseStorage면 `WarehouseStorageCommandService#updateWarehouseStatus(sale, ASSOCIATED_WITH_ORDER)` → `PaymentCommandService#processPayment`. **Order 상태는 PENDING_PAYMENT 그대로 유지, `order.assignPayment` 미호출.**
  - `processPaymentAndShipment(...)` (:112): 동기 버전. 컨트롤러 호출은 주석 처리되어 현재 **호출처 없음**.
  - `deleteOrder(orderId)` (:328).
- **OrderItemCommandService#createOrderItem(order, productSize, price)**: quantity=1.
- **OrderEventProducer** (`service/kafka`): `sendOrderProcessingEvent` → `order-processing-topic` (key=orderId), `sendOrderRetryEvent` → `order-retry-topic` (retryCount≥3이면 중단), `sendOrderProcessingEventSync`(호출처 없음).
- **OrderEventConsumer**: 아래 7절.
- **OrderBidQueryService**: `findById`, `findByOrderId`, `getOrderBids`, `getOrderBidStatusCounts`, `getOrderBidDetail`. **OrderItemQueryService#findById** (style 도메인에서 사용).

## 6. Repositories
- `OrderRepository`: `findByUser_EmailAndStatus`, `findByUserAndStatus`.
- `OrderBidRepository`: `findByOrderId`. Custom(`OrderBidRepositoryImpl`, QueryDSL):
  - `findOrderBidsByFilters(email, bidStatus, orderStatus, pageable)`: orderBid ⨝ user/productSize/productColor/product/thumbnailImage, leftJoin order/orderShipment → `OrderBidResponseDto` projection.
  - `countOrderBidsByStatus(email)`: PENDING / MATCHED / (CANCELLED+COMPLETED) 개수.
  - `findOrderBidById(orderBidId, email)`.
  - `tradeCountByColorIds(colorIds)`: status=COMPLETED OrderBid를 productColor별 count → product 도메인 `ProductQueryService`, `ProductColorSearchService`가 사용.

- product 도메인 `ProductQueryDslRepository`도 `QOrderBid`, `QOrderItem`을 직접 사용.

## 7. 외부 연동 / 비동기 (Kafka)
| 토픽 | Producer | Consumer (groupId, containerFactory) |

| `order-processing-topic` | OrderEventProducer#sendOrderProcessingEvent | OrderEventConsumer#handleOrderProcessingEvent (`order-processing-group`, `orderProcessingKafkaListenerContainerFactory`) |
| `order-retry-topic` | OrderEventProducer#sendOrderRetryEvent | OrderEventConsumer#handleOrderRetryEvent (`order-retry-group`) |
| `notification-topic` | OrderEventConsumer#sendSuccessNotification / sendFailureNotification (`notificationKafkaTemplate`, Map payload) | **코드 내 @KafkaListener 없음** |

- `handleOrderRetryEvent` (:121): `Thread.sleep(min(1000*retryCount, 5000))` 후 `handleOrderProcessingEvent` 재호출.

- sale: `SaleBidQueryService#findById`, `SaleBid#assignOrder/updateStatus`, `Sale` (OrderBid.sale).

# payment 도메인 네비게이션 맵

## 1. 개요

- 결제 실행 진입점은 `PaymentCommandService#processPayment` 하나 — order 도메인(Kafka consumer, 즉시구매)에서 호출. **payment 자체 결제 REST API는 없음** (컨트롤러는 PaymentInfo용뿐).
- Payment Kafka(producer/consumer)는 존재하지만 producer를 호출하는 코드가 없음.

- 설정 `payment.api.timeout`, `payment.retry.*`는 `@Value` 기본값 있음.

1	# notification 도메인 네비게이션
2	
3	## 1. 개요
4	- 사용자 대상 알림(쇼핑/스타일)을 DB(`Notification`)에 저장하고, WebSocket(STOMP, `/user/{email}/queue/notifications`)으로 실시간 푸시.
5	- 실시간 푸시는 Redis 키 `WebSocket:User:{email}` 존재 시에만 시도(연결된 사용자 판단). 푸시 실패해도 저장은 유지.
6	- 알림 생성은 주로 **다른 도메인 서비스가 `NotificationCommandService`를 직접 호출**하는 방식(Kafka 경유 아님). REST로도 생성 가능(관리자 체크 미구현).
7	- CQRS 분리: `controller/command`, `controller/query`, `service/command`, `service/query`.
8	
9	## 2. 패키지/파일 구조 (14 files)

198	## 10. 작업 팁 / 주의점
199	- `NotificationCommandService` 클래스 레벨 `@Transactional` → 다른 도메인 트랜잭션에 참여. `createNotification` 예외는 래핑되어 전파됨(호출자가 catch 안 하면 상위 트랜잭션 rollback-only).
200	- `markAllAsRead` (L140)는 모든 알림을 로드해 루프 처리(벌크 update 아님). `deleteNotificationsByUser`도 엔티티 로드 후 `deleteAll`.
201	- `deleteNotification` (L168)은 소유자 검증 없음 — 컨트롤러 주석(L120)에 "서비스에서 구현 필요".
202	- `POST /notifications`, `/broadcast`는 관리자 권한 체크 미구현(L53, L76). 인증만 되면 호출 가능.
203	- 페이징 조회 API는 `List`를 반환(총 개수 없음). 총 미읽음 수는 `/count/unread` 사용.
204	- 실시간 payload 형태가 단건(`NotificationDTO`)/전체(`List<NotificationDTO>`)/주문(`Map`)으로 섞여 같은 큐로 들어옴 — 클라이언트 파싱 시 주의.
205	- `NotificationDTO.createdAt`은 `LocalDateTime.toString()` 문자열.
206	- `handlePing`의 `extractEmailFromSecurityContext()`는 STOMP 메시지 처리 스레드의 `SecurityContextHolder`를 읽음(별도 ChannelInterceptor 없음).
207	- 의미상 배송/결제/판매 알림 대부분이 `NotificationType.BID`로 생성됨(TRADE/STORAGE 등은 사용처 없음).
208	- WebSocket allowed origin은 `https://www.pinjun.xyz` 하드코딩(WebSocketConfig L36).
